resources.string: Measures this phone against the on-device kernel checks in docs/ANDROID_KERNELS.md (S1): proot execution at targetSdk 34, 16 KB pages, time to kernel Ready, and Android\'s child-process limits with a foreground and a background phase. Nothing leaves the phone unless you share the report.

The child-process test starts 36 processes per phase, above Android\'s system-wide cap of 32. Android may kill the surplus — including other apps\' background child processes while the test runs. Stop other apps\' servers first if that matters. Close any running local kernel before starting.
Press Home now. The background phase runs under the foreground service; a notification tells you when it is done. Come back then, or tap Share report in that notification.
